Overall theme

Everyone is taken on an educational journey

Many people, both inside Spotler and among our customers, don’t yet understand what AI means for a software company. So we lead with education. Every audience learns how AI works alongside them as a buddy, and how to get real value from a product MCP and, later, SPOT.

One story, personalised to each audience

We launch MCP to internal teams first, followed by partners. In the new year, MCP launches to customers, followed later by a SPOT launch to everyone.

Timeline

Four launch moments

Each moment builds on the one before. MCP launches first, to the people closest to us. SPOT follows for everyone.

MCP launch: internal, partners, customersSPOT: everyone
MCP firstThe first three launches are MCP only. SPOT then extends MCP rather than competing with it.
Partners shape what followsFeedback from the partner beta refines the messaging for customers and prospects.
Prospects wait for SPOTProspects get no messaging until SPOT is ready, so their first experience is the full release.

      Launch moment 1 · w/c 16 Nov to w/c 30 Nov

      Internal launch

      Our own core teams go first, so they can explain AI as a buddy and answer customer questions with confidence.

      Objective

      Every core team can explain Spotler AI as a buddy, has used the Mail+ and Activate beta MCP themselves, and can confidently answer customer questions on data and access before partners and customers hear about it.

      Audience

      AMs, sales, CS, support and partner teams

      w/c 16 Nov to w/c 30 Nov

      Personalisation at scale for prospects

      The SPOT launch is the only moment that uses the marketing agent. It writes a hyper-personalised email journey for every prospect.

      For the SPOT launch, a marketing agent personalises every prospect email. The agent reads each prospect’s website and what HubSpot knows about them, then writes five personalised fields inside the email template marketing designs: their industry, the headline, why SPOT matters to them, one thing they could ask it to do, and a call to action that opens Mia. Every field is checked automatically, marketing signs off a sample before the first send, and every email goes out through Mail+.

      Show an example for a prospect
      in

      One launch list of prospects

      Marketing chooses the prospects it already emails in Mail+, across all core regions. Each business email address is matched to its company in HubSpot, so customers go to their own SPOT series instead. Intent signals decide the order within launch week.

      Mail+ list, matched to HubSpot
      • Not in marketing’s launch segment
      • Opted out, bounced or preferences say no
      • No clear basis to email
      • Churned account
      • In an active sales conversation
      The SPOT prospect launch list

      Standard 6 reads every company’s website

      The same reader behind our website chat and outbound works out what each company does, what it sells and who it sells to. Alongside what HubSpot knows, that decides which SPOT use case fits them best.

      The launch email, written for them

      Marketing designs each launch email once, carrying the proposition, the pillars and the product’s support line. One prompt writes five fields in natural language, using the SPOT use cases and tone marketing has approved for that industry.

      1. Industry label: their world, named on the image
      2. Headline: the launch, written for what they do
      3. Intro: why SPOT matters to them
      4. Use case: one thing they could ask it to do
      5. Call to action: opens Mia, in their terms

      Every field checked against the launch claims

      Automated checks and an independent AI reviewer read each field against the company’s website and the approved SPOT claims, so nothing promises more than the product does. Anything in doubt is replaced with marketing’s standard version. Before the first send, marketing signs off a sample.

      Automated checks and an AI reviewer
      • Matches what their website says
      • Only approved SPOT claims
      • Approved tone for their industry
      • Nothing invented
      • Reads naturally in the design
      When in doubt

      use_caseMarketing’s standard version used

      The fields fill Mail+, and the launch sends on its timeline

      The written fields land on each contact, with segmentation fields alongside. Marketing schedules the five SPOT emails like any other Mail+ campaign, with timings set once the SPOT date is confirmed.

      Measuring success

      Success measures for each audience

      Each launch moment is measured against its own objective, from engagement with the emails and hub through to the outcome we want. Targets to be agreed.

      1
      Internal launchw/c 16 Nov to w/c 30 Nov
      Engagement
      • Internal email opens and clicks through to the internal hub
      • Internal hub visits and prompt library use
      Outcome
      • Share of core team members who complete the training
      • Share who connect the Mail+ or Activate beta MCP and complete a first task
      • Confidence answering customer questions on data and access, from a short pulse survey
      • Customers nominated for the beta
      2
      Partners launchw/c 30 Nov to w/c 14 Dec
      Engagement
      • Partner email opens and clicks through to the internal hub
      • Partners onboarded and active in the beta
      Outcome
      • Tasks completed by partners in real use
      • Feedback Pro response rate and satisfaction
      • Feedback items fed into the roadmap and changes made
      • Partner use cases ready to share in January
      3
      Customers launchJanuary
      Engagement
      • Customer email opens and clicks through to the external hub
      • External hub visits, prompt library use and Mia conversations
      Outcome
      • Customers who connect a product MCP
      • Customers who complete a first task
      • Customers who use it again within 30 days
      • Customers taking the guided route who move to connected
      4
      SPOT launchDate TBC
      Customers
      • SPOT first use and repeat use
      • Customers using both SPOT and an MCP
      Prospects
      • Personalised email delivery, replies and clicks through to Mia
      • Mia conversations started by prospects
      • Qualified enquiries and demo requests
      • Sales opportunities and pipeline generated
      Live reporting

      A Claude and HubSpot report will be created so we can track the performance of each launch moment in real time, from email engagement through to adoption and pipeline.
